mapper.select: SELECT id, title, status, is_pinned, user_id, create_time, update_time FROM luck_chat_session WHERE status != 'deleted' ORDER BY is_pinned DESC, update_time DESC
SELECT id, title, status, is_pinned, user_id, create_time, update_time FROM luck_chat_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status != 'deleted' ORDER BY is_pinned DESC, update_time DESC

SELECT id, title, status, is_pinned, user_id, create_time, update_time FROM luck_chat_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status != 'deleted' ORDER BY is_pinned DESC, update_time DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM luck_chat_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status != 'deleted'
SELECT id, title, status, is_pinned, user_id, create_time, update_time FROM luck_chat_session WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND status != 'deleted'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO luck_chat_session (id, title, status, is_pinned, user_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{status}, #{isPinned}, #{userId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE luck_chat_session SET update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE luck_chat_session SET is_pinned = #{isPinned}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE luck_chat_session SET title = #{title}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE luck_chat_session SET status = 'deleted', update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE luck_chat_session SET status = 'deleted', update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
